There's only been one actual remake. And that's the remake of Resident Evil 1. Everything else has been a remaster/port. There's a huge difference. A remaster just cleans up the graphics a little and makes it look a little prettier. A remake builds the game again from scratch, adding new content and reimagining some things.

Guys! I have this great idea for a new game.

Remember how everyone used to love Resident Evil? Remember how it was an action puzzler filled with jump scares? Remember how people enjoyed it alongside horror games such as Silent Hill.

So you remember when we completely fucked it up and got rid of the zombies and replaced it with french tentacle people who enexplicably live in third-world conditions despite being in a first world country? Yeah, and how we turned it into a non stop action packed thrill ride that lost all of it's uniqueness? Yeah, cod with "zombies". Yeah and the magical guy who sold you stuff?

This isn't going to be a remaster (which are what the PC versions of the original Resident Evil remake and RE0 are). This is going to be a remake in the vein of the remake of the original Resident Evil. They're rebuilding the game from the ground up. It's - for all intents and purposes - a different game. Just like the Gamecube remake of the first game is a different game when compared to the original PS1 version.
